# KorpaBee Blog — Verified NYSC Knowledge Base

> Official publication and editorial guide repository powered by KorpaBee Technologies for Nigerian Prospective Corps Members (PCMs) and serving Youth Corps Members.

## Overview
KorpaBee Blog publishes verified, authoritative guidance covering the entire National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) lifecycle:
- Verification of senate lists, JAMB regularization, and green card printing
- NYSC mobilization calendars, batch batches (Batch A, B, C Stream 1 & 2)
- State orientation camp packing checklists, rules, mammy market guide
- Place of Primary Assignment (PPA) acceptance, rejection, and relocation protocols
- Monthly allawee payment tracking, biometric clearance, and CDS requirements
- Post-service job readiness, ATS CV building, and career growth
